risk_note: DSX-48 (规划/05 §3.11.3 DSX-48 + DSX-108, D10-837 ③ / D10-838): contracts/design-tokens.json replaced verbatim by the planning repo snapshot 0.5.2 (c98ae93f, couli #296) with the contracts/README line updated; the ui-tokens generator accepts duration (ms, non-negative) and cubicBezier (four numbers, x in [0,1]) and regenerates tokens.gen.css / tailwind.gen.css / theme.gen.ts plus a11y.gen.css (reduced-motion and forced-colors rules, exported as ./a11y.css) and motion.gen.ts (millisecond values; the full token object would push the app entry past the 150 KiB gate). H5: skeleton shimmer on --motion-skeleton-shimmer that stops under reduced motion, useDelayedVisible (shows only after show-delay, stays at least min-visible) wired into the rules page first screen, system-colour 1px edges on base pressables and the skeleton under forced colours, toast at the top inside the App (bridge present at mount) and at the bottom off-site (fix program L370). The frozen ui-tokens tests were made two-state by the prior test-change CT-11bt (#2758, D10-965 after D10-964 could not land under the gates), which also took the .prettierignore line for the verbatim c98ae93 fixtures; this branch no longer touches test/spec/frontend/ui-tokens/** or .prettierignore and declares no red_exempt. Rule tests by an independent Claude in two rounds; Codex spec-test review r1 pass; red on the local container. Implementation by Opus 5.5: local container browser run green; container verify-fast OOM-killed at tsc twice, host jsdom h5-* / ui-tokens / lint-style-web rule tests, ui-tokens and h5 unit tests, eslint and prettier stand in, CI runs full verification. Non-funds. The branch was rebuilt on main after CT-11bt (rule tests = h5-state-motion only; implementation identical to the reviewed commit minus the .prettierignore line). Codex money review hit the Codex usage limit (until 11-15), so per D10-823 ④ an independent Claude did the money review: round 1 pass, no findings. Written by hand.
